intent: Endless vertical columns of greyscale testimonial cards drifting at different speeds, masked top and bottom. Cards cascade in from a blur in reading order, the drift sets off from rest, and hovering or focusing a column eases it to a stop.

stack.animation: requestAnimationFrame per column writing transforms directly; motion/react animate() for the imperative first-view cascade, useInView and useReducedMotion

layout.root: @container section, fixed height 720px (one column caps at 600px)
layout.columns: ResizeObserver on root: 3 from 900px, 2 from 560px, else 1; testimonials dealt round-robin; gap 16px (20px @3xl)
layout.viewport: overflow hidden; mask linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, #000 18%, #000 82%, transparent)
layout.track: three copies of the set (clone, real, clone); one set height including trailing gap = period P; repeat items if P < viewport height
layout.card: figure, radius 16px, padding 20px (24px @3xl); quote then caption row with a 32px initials disc inside a 36px hairline ring
layout.pause: 32px round button with a 44px hit area, bottom-right
layout.structure: sub-components Column, StaticColumn, Card, Quote, Avatar, VerifiedSeal, PauseButton; hooks useColumnCount, useOnScreen, useCascade

typography.quote: 15px, leading 1.6, tracking -0.005em, body grey, text-wrap pretty; **phrase** in ink
typography.name: 14px, weight 500, tracking -0.01em, ink

color.approach: monochrome first; tokens in one PALETTE object exposed as --wall-* CSS variables; theme prop dark (default) | light
color.dark: card #0c0c0d (hover #111113), hairline white/7%, top highlight white/5%, ink #f4f4f5, quote #94949a, meta #7c7c84, avatar #2c2c30→#151517 with #d4d4d8 initials, ring white/22%, spotlight white 5.5%, border arc white 42%, pause #141416
color.light: card #ffffff, hairline rgba(24,24,27,.08), ink #18181b, quote #5b5b63, meta #71717a, avatar #f4f4f5→#e4e4e7 with #3f3f46 initials, spotlight rgba(24,24,27,.035), arc .28, grey lift shadow
color.accent: one accent prop (default theme ink): the verified seal; check colour black or white by luminance
color.never: hue-per-person avatars, blue badges, tinted cards

motion.drift: per-column speeds 24, 30, 20 px/s; odd columns down, even up; phase offset P * ((i*0.37 + 0.11) mod 1); columns start at rest and set off 0.85s after the entrance
motion.velocityEasing: v += (goal - v) * (1 - exp(-dt / tau)); tau 0.32s when stopping (hover/focus/paused), 0.7s when resuming
motion.wrap: y modulo P; seamless because copies are identical
motion.focusGlide: focused card moves fully into view, margin max(56px, 15% height), exponential follow tau 0.11s
motion.cardHover: lift 3px, surface #111113, deep shadow, spotlight fades in; 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)
motion.entrance: once at 20% in view: each on-screen card rises 14px out of an 8px blur over 0.5s ease-out [0.22,1,0.36,1]; delay = column*50ms + (top / column height)*260ms (reading order); the avatar ring draws (dashoffset 1→0, pathLength 1) 160ms after its card lands over 0.55s; pause button rises 6px from a 4px blur at 0.62s; imperative animate(0,1,{onUpdate}) per card because the track is moved directly; unmount completes running tweens
motion.offscreen: loops stop when out of view or the tab is hidden
motion.reducedMotion: static grid at natural height: no masks, clones, drift or lift; 150ms fade in

responsive.units: container queries (@3xl) for gaps and card padding

accessibility: cards are focusable figures with blockquote + figcaption; focus stops the column and brings the card into view
scrollTop reset so focus never scrolls the clipped column
clones aria-hidden and inert; repeated items tabindex -1
pause/play button (scale 0.94 when pressed) with aria-pressed and a descriptive label

content.testimonials: 12 specific quotes, e.g. 'Our p95 build went from 9m 40s to 2m 12s. I checked twice because I assumed the cache was lying.' (Dana Okafor, Platform Lead, Fernway)

avoid: CSS keyframe marquees with animation-play-state (they stop dead)
more than one highlighted phrase per quote
a headline or section chrome around the wall
hue-from-name avatars or coloured verified badges
cards popping in all at once
